div.head: V Atr 13
div.ab: Sunnandæges freols healde man georne, swa þærto gebyrige.
Sunnandæges freols healde man georne, swa þærto gebyrige.
Sunnandæges freols healde man georne, swa ðarto gebirige.
Sunnandæges freols healde man georne swa ðarto gebirige.
Sunnandæges freols healde man georne, swa þærto gebyrige.
Sonntagsfeier halte man willig, wie sich dazu gehört.
Let the Sunday festival be eagerly kept, as befits it.
The festival of Sunday shall be diligently observed in a fitting manner.
The Sunday festival is to be diligently observed, as befits it.
The Sunday holy day shall be held properly, as is fitting thereto.
